chapter: Other Philadelphia work and the union
title: Never impressed by Joe Oliver; the Saratoga Club band folded
summary: Waters explains he took the Oliver dates only for money. He says Oliver's band broke up at the Saratoga Club while Charlie Johnson's kept going, and confirms Joe Oliver was King Oliver's name.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: No, just like I didn't know Joe Oliver too well (laughs).

You see what I mean, this is, somebody engaged me. First, they gotta, never said two words with Joe Oliver of all the successions (PS laughs), because Joe Oliver didn't say nothin' to no one, when he finished, you know? .... See, that's when you're a musician, don't remember things like that -

You see. They wasn't interested that much, only for the playing, and I wasn't interested, only for the money. See, it wasn't no prestige for me. It should have been, though, because Joe Oliver was great, obviously, even when I heard him play, see. But I was kind of egotistical then because I worked with some great musicians up there, playing 'rangements, fantastic arrangements. If you remember - 'cause you don't remember, maybe - but Joe Oliver's band broke up in New York, at the Saratoga Club, because it wasn't good enough. That's facts, that's facts. But Charlie Johnson's band was goin' on and on and on. See, so, I mean, you know what I'm talkin' about? - I was bein' egotistic. It broke up in the Saratoga Club. And Red Allen and Greely [Walton] and Barney Bigard and Albert Nicholas, all those guys were scattered, that's obvious. And they joined that band, that band, that band, that band - you see, it broke up, up there because it, they didn't do no business. Small's Paradise was packin' 'em in, you see what I mean? That's where the ego comes in.
Right, so what you're saying is that you've never made a, the King Oliver record dates did not make a strong impression on you because they were just -
And your main band was Charlie Johnson's band, and you would rather play with a better band -

Yeah, you see what I mean, that's because I, that's why I couldn't, don't remember because I wasn't interested that way. I should have been, though, because it's great, see. But I wasn't, you see what I mean? You wouldn't be, either, if you was workin' with that band and [ ]. But the people, though, people, they think it's great because I - (whispers) "You worked with Joe Oliver?"
Is there a reason why you say Joe Oliver instead of King Oliver? Was that what he was called, himself? How come you use the word Joe Oliver?
Well, that was the name on - I don't know, I saw that Joe on, somewhere on the music on the associating. But, King Oliver -
But in '27 you probably called him King Oliver 'cause that was how he was known -
Yes, King Oliver, yeah, surely. Well, that was his name, Joe Oliver, see.
